_about: Editorial layer for the Mega Stones section. The list of stones the aide gives is NOT typed here: tools/megastones.py reads it from data/scripts/hns_mega_stone_menus.inc and the build compares it with this file’s rules.

ring.how: Given by Professor Oak after you defeat Rocket Executive Archer.

aide.where: Professor Elm’s lab, New Bark Town
aide.who: The aide on the right-hand side of the lab
aide.requires: The Mega Ring in your Bag. Without it she says her usual line and offers nothing.
aide.cost: Free. One of each stone; asking again says you already have one.
aide.missable: No. The offer has no time limit and uses no save flags.
aide.region: Johto (open from the Radio Tower chapter onward, and for the rest of the game)

differences: In the official games Mega Stones are scattered across a region or sold; here every obtainable stone comes from one aide, free, as soon as you hold the Mega Ring.
The Mega Ring is given by Professor Oak in Johto, during the Radio Tower story, rather than by a regional professor’s assistant.
A Mega Stone also boosts moves of its holder’s first type by 20%, before and after Mega Evolving.
Mega Evolution is triggered with START on the FIGHT menu.
The roster includes Mega forms from Pokémon Legends: Z-A alongside the X/Y and Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire ones.
Rayquaza Mega Evolves by knowing Dragon Ascent and needs no stone.
